scope: Terminal-owned Update in Place and optional launcher request adapter

contracts.behavior: The real context menu is disabled without a different usable binary
No Application Launcher service is required; tmux reattaches to the exact live session before closing the old client
Non-tmux restarts require local confirmation and startup cannot execute until the original application exits
Replies and close authorization are bound to the window, PID, operation and unique helper owner
Retargeting, missing helpers, changed tabs, cancellation and failed preparation cannot close the original
Exact placement retains offscreen coordinates only for matching monitor metadata and reports the actual mismatch

Real tmux and confirmed two-tab shell updates complete under isolated software-rendered KWin, with no Application Launcher bus service, the same offscreen placement, active tab and working directories

environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG, session bus and Xvfb; mock worker, no tracker
environments.automated_backend: Temporary files, fake KWin backend and real private child startup sockets
environments.native_wayland: Automated disposable tmux and confirmed two-tab shell updates under private-bus, private-HOME, software-rendered KWin; real user windows are never replaced
